Message:
tg3: allow TSO on vlan devices

Similar to commit 72dccb01e8632aa (bnx2: Update vlan_features)

In order to enable TSO on vlan devices, tg3 needs to update
dev->vlan_features.

Tested on HP NC326m (aka BCM5715S (rev a3))
